proportional.def: y is directly proportional to x (y ∝ x) when y = kx for a constant k: multiplying x by any factor multiplies y by the same factor.

inverse-proportional.def: y is inversely proportional to x (y ∝ 1/x) when y = k/x: multiplying x by a factor divides y by that factor, so x × y stays constant.

functional-dependence.def: How one quantity changes when another changes, found from the equation that links them. Written as a factor: "if v doubles, d becomes 4 times as large".

square-relationship.def: A dependence on the square of a quantity, y ∝ x²: multiplying x by a factor multiplies y by that factor squared. An inverse square, y ∝ 1/x², divides y by the factor squared.
